outline.text: How to check word count in Microsoft Word
Open an existing document or create a blank document in Word for the web.
Enter text or copy and paste existing text to edit pre-written copy.
View total word count at the bottom left corner or select text to view specific word count for a section.
For detailed word count statistics, click the word count button in the bottom left corner to view reading time, paragraph count, and editor score.
Save and share as a PDF, Word document, or OneDrive link.
